parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the query.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID. For more information about how to obtain an instance ID, see [ListInstances](~~470439~~).

parameters.name: Limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of sessions to return in the query.

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description:
The order in which to sort the results. Valid values:

- ASC: ascending order by time.

- DESC: descending order by time.

parameters.name: SessionNumber
parameters.description: A session is the period from when an instance is started until it fails or is stopped. sessionNumber specifies the ordinal number offset of the session.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the query.

parameters.name: Token
parameters.description: A token used for sharing URLs.
